title: Fred again.. & Latin Mafia to Host Mixtape Production Livestream That Won’t End Until the Mixtape Is Done
summary: The British producer and Mexican trio will start the stream 1 p.m. CT on July 28.
contentText:
Fred again.. and Latin Mafia will livestream themselves making a mixtape together and advise that this livestream will go on for as long as it takes for them to complete the project.

The stream happens from Mexico City on Tuesday (July 28) and will start at 1 p.m. CT. Fans can tune into the event here . The stream follows the July 26 release of under the fabric (Mexico City, 11th December 2025) , a 35-minute film documenting the session that inspired the start of this project. Latin Mafia were among the special guests for Fred’s show in Mexico City this past Dec. 12, with this show wrapping his 1 0 shows in 10 weeks in 10 cities run.

Announcing the event on Monday (July 27) Fred wrote that “Me and the Latin mafia brothers have been working on music for many moons now. They are makin some of my favourite music in the world right now. It’s so beautiful but surprising but contained but adventurous. Its a joy to link wit these guys always. They’re 3 brothers and I make music wit my lil brother as well so its jus 5 brothers every time we get together. And we’re both managed by our siblings too! So yeah proper family affair.

“We been working on ideas for the last couple years together on and off,” Fred’s statement continues. “It was mad how quickly everything we made felt like it was naturally part of the same world, like sometimes I find I have to really work hard to make things feel like a contained universe, but in this case everything that came out just naturally felt like one thing to us all. So we wanna put it all out as one project. We’ve decided to get together in their home of Mexico City to finish it all.”

The livestream comes on the heels of Fred’s appearance at Eaux Claires, Justin Vernon’s festival in his hometown of Eau Claire, Wisconsin, that returned from an eight-year hiatus this past weekend, July 24-25.
